comply-in.span: Processes text, images, and audio together to understand the whole context.
Learns shared meaning by mapping visual, auditory, and textual inputs into one space.
Accepts interleaved content without losing relationships between modalities or sequence.
Answers questions that require combining visual, auditory, and textual evidence.

p: Multimodal AI is an artificial intelligence system that simultaneously processes and integrates more than one input type, typically text, images, audio, and video, within a single model or orchestrated pipeline. Instead of treating each modality in isolation, these systems learn aligned representations that map concepts across different formats, enabling capabilities such as captioning an image, answering questions about a photo, transcribing and summarizing audio, and generating responses that reference visual and spoken evidence in one unified interaction.

sec-head.p: The five-stage pipeline that lets a multimodal model align an image, a spoken question, and text into one grounded response.

card.p: Text, image, and audio encoders convert each input into numerical representations.
The model maps visual, auditory, and textual patches into a shared embedding space.
Attention layers relate image regions, audio segments, and words to one another.
The model synthesizes evidence across all modalities to interpret the full request.
It generates an answer that can include text, audio, or a visual reference.
